metadata.organization: Nepal Applied Mathematics and Informatics Institute for Research (NAAMII)
metadata.countryContext: Nepal (LMIC / ODA-Eligible South Asia / UNESCO-TWAS STLC)

externalPortals.name: ScientifyResearch
externalPortals.tip: Filter by Subject: 'Artificial Intelligence' or 'Global Health' + Applicant Location: 'Unrestricted / Developing Countries / Asia'.

externalPortals.name: IDRC Funding Calls (Canada)
externalPortals.tip: Primary hub for AI4GH (AI for Global Health) and AI4D calls where Southern research institutes lead directly.

externalPortals.name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (Horizon Europe)
externalPortals.tip: Nepal is automatically eligible for EC grant funding as an LMIC. Search Cluster 1 (Health) & Cluster 4 (Digital/AI) and use the Partner Search tab.

externalPortals.name: NIH Fogarty International Center
externalPortals.tip: Check 'Non-US / Foreign Institutions Eligible' notices, K43 Career Awards, and Mobile Health / Data Science FOAs.

externalPortals.name: Wellcome Trust Funding Schemes
externalPortals.tip: Discovery schemes run on rolling deadlines; targeted Digital Health, Climate-Health, and EVAH calls allow direct LMIC leads.

externalPortals.name: UK NIHR Global Health Research
externalPortals.tip: NIHR focuses on South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa. Requires joint UK + Nepal Co-Leads under ODA compliance.

externalPortals.name: Global Grand Challenges Network
externalPortals.tip: Tracks Gates Foundation, Grand Challenges Canada, and regional South Asia RFPs for AI in primary healthcare.

externalPortals.name: Lacuna Fund & APNIC Foundation
externalPortals.tip: Monitor Lacuna Fund for LMIC dataset curation RFPs and APNIC/ISIF Asia for regional digital infrastructure grants.

grants.title: Evidence for AI in Health (EVAH) Initiative
grants.funder: Gates Foundation, Wellcome & Novo Nordisk Foundation
grants.nepalEligibility: Directly eligible. Specifically prioritizes locally led research institutions in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Sub-Saharan Africa.
grants.summary: Flagship $60M joint global health fund supporting locally led real-world evaluations of mature or deployment-ready AI health tools (clinical decision support, frontline triage, diagnostic imaging) in LMIC primary and community care.
grants.naamiiStrategy: High-priority target for TOGAI & TrAI Labs. Leverage NAAMII's WHO SEARO Project Collaboration Agreement and Nepali hospital partnerships to propose rigorous clinical safety, equity, and cost-effectiveness evaluations.

grants.title: Mozilla Human-Scale AI Incubator (2026–2027)
grants.nepalEligibility: Open globally to non-profit labs, researchers, and builders; strong emphasis on Global South and community-owned alternatives.
grants.summary: Supports builders creating smaller, specialized, open-source, and resource-efficient AI technologies tailored to local communities rather than monolithic frontier models.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Pitch compact, offline-capable medical triage models for rural Nepal health posts or open-weights Nepali/regional low-resource language infrastructure.

grants.title: Artificial Intelligence for Global Health (AI4GH) & AI4D
grants.nepalEligibility: Directly eligible as Lead Institution. IDRC mandates leadership by Global South / LMIC institutions.
grants.summary: Funds Southern-led research networks and implementation hubs developing responsible, ethical, and gender-responsive AI solutions for public health surveillance, sexual/reproductive/maternal health, and clinical workflows in Asia and Africa.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Position NAAMII as a South Asia regional research hub alongside partners in Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, or Vietnam; emphasize data sovereignty, gender equity, and NHRC ethical integration.

grants.title: SNSF SPIRIT — Swiss Programme for International Research Teams
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is on the OECD DAC ODA list and explicitly eligible as an equal Co-PI partner alongside a Swiss university/institute.
grants.summary: Supports equitable cross-border scientific investigation teams across all disciplines. Unlike many Northern grants, SPIRIT allows substantial direct budget allocation, salaries, equipment, and institutional project costs in Nepal.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Partner with Swiss AI/medical imaging labs (ETH Zurich, EPFL, Univ. of Bern, Idiap, Univ. of Zurich). Ideal for 3–4 year PhD/Postdoc co-supervision and hardware support at NAAMII.

grants.title: Lacuna Fund — Open Machine Learning Datasets for LMICs
grants.nepalEligibility: Lead organization MUST be headquartered or have substantial research operations in an LMIC such as Nepal.
grants.summary: World's first collaborative fund mobilizing labeled, open, and ethically sourced training and evaluation ML datasets to solve urgent problems in health, underserved languages, climate, and agriculture in LMICs.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Strong fit for curating benchmark datasets in Nepali/Maithili/Newari/Tamang NLP, annotated portable ultrasound/X-ray datasets from Nepali hospitals, or Himalayan hazard datasets.

grants.title: NIH Fogarty Emerging Global Leader Award (K43)
grants.nepalEligibility: Restricted exclusively to citizens/residents of LMICs holding a junior faculty or research scientist position at an LMIC institution (NAAMII qualifies with eRA Commons/SAM registration).
grants.summary: Provides 3–5 years of intensively mentored research career development support and project funding for early-career LMIC health scientists transitioning to research independence.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Ideal for early-career PhD researchers in NAAMII's TOGAI or TrAI labs. Requires one primary LMIC mentor in Nepal and one US collaborator mentor.

grants.title: Horizon Europe: AI Predictive Biomarkers for Chronic NCDs (HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01)
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is classified as a Low-to-Middle-Income Country automatically eligible for direct European Commission funding in Horizon Europe consortia.
grants.summary: Two-stage Horizon Europe Health call supporting development and clinical validation of AI methodologies for predictive biomarkers of disease progression and treatment response in chronic non-communicable diseases.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Join a European-led consortium (minimum 3 EU/Associated partners) as the South Asian AI & clinical validation partner to boost cross-population generalizability and equity scores.

grants.title: Horizon Europe: AI & Data Analytics to Reduce Polypharmacy Risks (HORIZON-HLTH-2027-01-CARE-02)
grants.nepalEligibility: Legal entities established in Nepal are automatically eligible for EU funding as full beneficiaries in Horizon Europe consortia.
grants.summary: Funds personalized, data-driven, and AI-assisted clinical decision-support tools to prevent adverse drug reactions from multi-medication administration.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Offer expertise in clinical workflow translation (TrAI Lab) and low-resource EHR/prescription safety testing across diverse patient cohorts.

grants.title: NIHR Global Health Research (RIGHT / Groups / Units — South Asia Priority)
grants.funder: National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR, UK)
grants.deadlineDisplay: Recurring Calls (2026–2027 South Asia Priority Focus)
grants.nepalEligibility: High priority! Starting 2026, NIHR narrowed Global Health Research to South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa. Requires joint UK Lead + Nepal Co-Lead.
grants.summary: Large-scale ODA-funded applied health research tackling NCDs, antimicrobial resistance, maternal care, and health system strengthening—including digital health, mHealth triage, and portable diagnostics.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Co-design bids with existing UK academic collaborators (Oxford, King's College London, UCL, Imperial, Warwick). NIHR strongly rewards capacity building (PhDs/Postdocs hosted in Nepal).

grants.title: TWAS Research Grants Programme in Basic Sciences (Individuals & Units)
grants.funder: The World Academy of Sciences (TWAS / UNESCO) & Sida
grants.nepalEligibility: Top priority! Restricted to 66 Science & Technology Lagging Countries (STLCs) — Nepal is explicitly listed.
grants.summary: One of the few international grants dedicated specifically to purchasing scientific equipment (compute workstations, imaging/sequencing hardware, sensors), consumables, and training MSc students at STLC research institutes.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Apply as a NAAMII Research Unit to acquire dedicated local GPU servers, edge diagnostic hardware, or bioinformatics lab equipment without heavy consortium overhead.

grants.title: ISIF Asia — Information Society Innovation Fund Grants
grants.nepalEligibility: Directly eligible for registered non-profit and research organizations in Nepal (APNIC Asia-Pacific service region).
grants.summary: Funds technical research, open-source infrastructure deployments, network security, community connectivity, and digital inclusion innovations across developing Asia-Pacific economies.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Propose edge-compute tele-health connectivity for rural Nepali municipalities or open-source regional AI/network infrastructure benchmarks.

grants.title: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program (GPU Hardware & Cloud Hours)
grants.amountDisplay: RTX / Jetson Hardware Grants or up to 32,000+ H100 GPU Hours
grants.nepalEligibility: Open internationally to full-time faculty/researchers (pair with degree-granting Nepali or international co-PI where portal specifies PhD-granting affiliation).
grants.summary: Provides physical NVIDIA GPUs (RTX PRO, Jetson edge kits) and Brev/Cloud H100 cluster hours for frontier research in AI training/inference, medical imaging, simulation, and autonomous systems.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Submit focused proposals on low-bit medical imaging foundation models or Jetson-deployed portable ultrasound triage; co-apply with TU/KU faculty if degree-granting host status is required.

grants.title: AWS Cloud Credit for Research Program
grants.nepalEligibility: Open globally to full-time researchers and faculty at accredited academic and non-profit research institutions.
grants.summary: Supports researchers building cloud-hosted scientific pipelines, training ML/bioinformatics models on EC2 GPU instances, or hosting open medical/climate benchmarks.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Apply per-project across NAAMII labs to offload heavy GPU training runs and host open Nepali NLP or medical imaging benchmarks without burning cash grant budgets.

grants.title: Google Cloud Research Credits Program
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to researchers at recognized non-profit research institutes and universities in supported countries.
grants.summary: Fast-turnaround Google Cloud credits for GPU/TPU compute, BigQuery, Earth Engine climate analysis, and Vertex AI experimentation.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Stack multiple PI and student credit awards across ANAIS fellows and research groups for rapid prototyping before scaling to larger grants.

grants.title: Wellcome Discovery Research Schemes (Early-Career, Career Dev & Discovery)
grants.nepalEligibility: Under Wellcome's 2026 rules, Nepal institutions participate strongly as funded Co-Applicant sites in Discovery Awards led by UK or eligible LMIC hub institutions.
grants.summary: Wellcome transitioned its flagship Discovery Research schemes to always-open rolling deadlines, funding bold, foundational, and methodological breakthroughs in human health, computational biology, and AI diagnostics.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Team up as a funded Co-Applicant with UK universities (e.g., Oxford/OUCRU network, Imperial, Sanger) to fund multi-year AI/genomics teams and equipment in Kathmandu.

grants.title: Wellcome Targeted Calls: Climate & Health / Digital Infectious Disease Tools
grants.nepalEligibility: Targeted global programmes (Mental Health, Climate & Health, Infectious Disease) explicitly allow direct Lead Applicants from LMICs including Nepal.
grants.summary: Mission-driven calls funding open-source digital public health modeling, AI-driven vector-borne outbreak forecasting, and living evidence synthesis hubs in high-burden regions.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Nepal's steep altitudinal climate gradient (Terai to Himalayas) makes it a sentinel site for dengue/malaria expansion—combine remote sensing ML with epidemiological modeling.

grants.title: Global Grand Challenges — Catalyzing Equitable AI for Global Health
grants.nepalEligibility: Directly open to LMIC non-profits, research institutes, and universities; typically 80%+ of awards go directly to LMIC-led organizations.
grants.summary: Backs locally owned AI/LLM and multimodal decision-support pilots improving Female Community Health Volunteer (FCHV) workflows, clinical triage, and public health communication in local languages.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Combine Nepali voice/NLP interfaces with TrAI Lab's clinical triage protocols tailored for Nepal's Female Community Health Volunteers (FCHVs).

grants.title: Grand Challenges Canada — Stars in Global Health & Transition to Scale
grants.funder: Grand Challenges Canada (Funded by Government of Canada)
grants.nepalEligibility: Legally incorporated non-profits and research institutes in Nepal are directly eligible across Global Health and Climate-Health streams.
grants.summary: Supports bold, locally led health innovations integrating scientific/AI breakthroughs with social and clinical delivery—particularly climate-health early warning, maternal care, and youth mental health.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Strong avenue to take validated NAAMII prototypes (e.g., low-cost ophthalmic/chest screening or heat/air-quality health alerts) from lab validation into district hospital deployment.

grants.title: Mozilla Foundation Fellowships (2027–2028 Cohort)
grants.deadlineDisplay: LOI Late Dec 2026 / Full App Early 2027
grants.nepalEligibility: Open globally with strong representation from the Global South across Embedded (with civil society hosts) and Independent tracks.
grants.summary: Supports tech leaders, researchers, and builders working on open-source AI auditing, dataset equity, health data governance, and public-interest AI tools.
grants.naamiiStrategy: NAAMII researchers can apply individually on the Independent track, or NAAMII can explore serving as a Global South research host organization.

grants.title: GSMA Innovation Fund (AI-Enabled Impact & Digital Inclusion)
grants.funder: GSMA Mobile for Development & UK FCDO
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is an ODA-eligible country explicitly covered by UK FCDO-backed GSMA Innovation Fund rounds (requires enterprise/social-venture lead or implementation partner).
grants.summary: Funds mobile-delivered AI, voice/NLP, and data-driven solutions improving climate resilience, health/financial inclusion, and digital access for underserved populations in LMICs.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Partner as the core AI R&D partner alongside a Nepali fintech, agri-tech, or digital health enterprise (e.g., eSewa/F1Soft/YoungInnovations ecosystem).

grants.title: NIH Fogarty: Mobile Health & AI Innovations for LMICs (R21/R33)
grants.funder: NIH / Fogarty International Center, NIBIB & NIMH
grants.deadlineDisplay: Annual Cycles (Check active PAR notices for 2027)
grants.nepalEligibility: Eligible as Foreign Lead Institution on select Fogarty FOAs or as Multiple-PI (MPI) partner with a US university; adhere to NIH foreign subaward guidelines.
grants.summary: Supports milestone-driven R21/R33 engineering and clinical validation of smartphone-based diagnostics, portable imaging AI, and behavioral/clinical mHealth tools in LMICs.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Strong fit for NAAMII's low-cost ophthalmology, fetal/point-of-care ultrasound, and chest radiography AI tools co-developed with Nepali teaching hospitals and US academic partners.

grants.title: WHO / TDR Implementation Research & Digital Health Small Grants
grants.funder: WHO Special Programme for Research & Training in Tropical Diseases (TDR) / SEARO
grants.nepalEligibility: Exclusively open to researchers and institutions based in LMICs within the relevant WHO region (Nepal is in WHO SEARO).
grants.summary: Targeted implementation research grants addressing infectious diseases of poverty (TB, dengue, visceral leishmaniasis, AMR) and digital health integration in primary care.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Builds directly on NAAMII's existing Project Collaboration Agreement with WHO SEARO; great mechanism for junior PIs to lead independent field validation studies.

grants.title: OWSD Early Career Fellowship (Women Scientists in STLCs)
grants.funder: Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World (UNESCO / IDRC)
grants.amountDisplay: Up to $50,000 USD (Includes Equipment & Local Lab Setup)
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is an eligible Science & Technology Lagging Country (STLC). Open to women PhDs in STEM employed at Nepali research/academic institutes.
grants.summary: Prestigious 2–3 year award enabling women PhD scientists in STLCs to establish local research groups, purchase workstation/laboratory hardware, and build industry/clinical links.
grants.naamiiStrategy: High-impact grant for women PhD researchers at NAAMII—funds physical GPU/lab equipment that stays permanently at the host institute in Nepal.

grants.title: Google.org Impact Challenges (AI for Science & Global Goals)
grants.nepalEligibility: Registered non-profit research institutes and NGOs in Nepal are directly eligible.
grants.summary: Multi-million dollar philanthropic challenges backing organizations using AI to achieve scientific breakthroughs in life sciences, global health diagnostics, and climate/disaster resilience.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Highlight NAAMII's track record as Nepal's premier non-profit AI research institute and prior Google ecosystem engagement; propose open-source South Asian health or Himalayan cryosphere models.

grants.title: Amazon Research Awards (ARA)
grants.amountDisplay: Up to $80,000 Unrestricted Gift + $40,000 AWS Credits
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to full-time faculty and principal investigators at academic institutions and recognized non-profit research organizations worldwide.
grants.summary: Provides unrestricted cash gifts plus AWS promotional credits for 1-year open-source research across computer vision, fairness/auditing, ML theory, healthcare/sustainability, and automated reasoning.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Target Spring/Fall tracks aligned with NAAMII's strengths in robust computer vision under domain shift, low-resource fairness, or medical ML.

grants.title: Microsoft AI for Good Lab — Azure Compute & Collaborative Research
grants.funder: Microsoft Philanthropies / AI for Good Research Lab
grants.amountDisplay: Substantial Azure GPU Compute Credits + Joint Engineering
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to non-profit research institutes, NGOs, and universities worldwide.
grants.summary: Couples high-end Azure GPU cloud compute with joint collaboration alongside Microsoft AI for Good data scientists on retinopathy/radiology screening, maternal health, biodiversity, and glacier/flood risk.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Strong fit for both TOGAI (ophthalmic/radiology screening) and Himalayan glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) / Earth observation ML.

grants.title: Meta Llama Impact Grants & APAC Innovation Awards
grants.nepalEligibility: Non-profits, academic/research institutions, and organizations in eligible APAC countries are eligible.
grants.summary: Supports organizations fine-tuning and deploying open-source Llama models for high-impact social applications in healthcare, education, agriculture, and underserved languages.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Pitch fine-tuned Nepali/Maithili Llama clinical communication assistants or AI tutoring infrastructure building on NAAMII's UDAAN & ANAIS reach.

grants.title: Royal Society International Exchanges (Global Round)
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to any overseas non-profit/academic research co-applicant partnering with a UK-based scientist.
grants.summary: Flexible bilateral seed grant funding research visits, student/postdoc exchanges, and exploratory experiments across mathematics, computer science, engineering, and biological sciences.
grants.naamiiStrategy: High success-rate seed mechanism to bring UK collaborators to Kathmandu (e.g., around ANAIS) and co-author pilot papers ahead of £1M+ NIHR or Wellcome bids.

grants.title: Human Frontier Science Program (HFSP) — Research Grants
grants.funder: International Human Frontier Science Program Organization
grants.nepalEligibility: Principal Applicant must be in an HFSP member country (e.g., India, EU, UK, US, Japan, Switzerland), while Co-PIs can be based in ANY country including Nepal with full budget share.
grants.summary: Prestigious basic-science grants supporting novel, intercontinental teams combining mathematics, physics, and machine learning with fundamental biology and microbiome/neuroscience.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Join a 3-country interdisciplinary team (e.g., Switzerland/Japan/India + NAAMII Nepal) bringing mathematical modeling and ML to frontier biological questions.

grants.title: The Pfizer Foundation — Global Health Innovation Grants (GHIG)
grants.funder: The Pfizer Foundation & Innovations in Healthcare
grants.nepalEligibility: Directly open to non-profit organizations and social enterprises operating in Low- and Lower-Middle-Income Countries including Nepal.
grants.summary: Supports locally driven healthcare delivery innovations—including AI triage, digital diagnostics, and AMR tracking—that strengthen primary care quality in LMICs.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Focus on deployment-stage tools inside Nepali community hospitals with measurable patient throughput and diagnostic accuracy metrics.

grants.title: Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (CZI) — Biomedical Imaging & AI Biology RFAs
grants.nepalEligibility: Global non-profit research institutions (foreign equivalents to 501(c)(3)) are eligible on CZI's international Science & Imaging RFAs.
grants.summary: Funds open-source biomedical imaging tools, low-cost microscopy AI, single-cell computational biology, and expanding global bioimaging expertise in underrepresented regions.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Strong match for NAAMII's medical imaging & computational biology groups—especially open-source Python packages and LMIC imaging hub capacity.

grants.title: Wellcome Leap — Breakthrough Health & Bio-AI Challenge Programs
grants.nepalEligibility: Open globally to universities, non-profit research institutes, and companies willing to sign the Wellcome Leap Master Academic Research Funding Agreement.
grants.summary: ARPA-style, fast-contracting multi-million dollar programs funding unconventional, quantitative, and AI-enabled breakthroughs in women's health, resilient microbiomes, and clinical care.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Pre-review Wellcome Leap's standard Master Research Agreement so NAAMII can respond rapidly within the 30-day abstract window when relevant bio-AI topics drop.

grants.title: J-PAL Project AI Evidence (PAIE) — LMIC Scholars & Pilot RCT Grants
grants.funder: Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL)
grants.nepalEligibility: Designed specifically for PhD researchers residing and holding research appointments in LMICs in Asia and Africa.
grants.summary: Supports LMIC-based researchers with training, J-PAL affiliate mentorship, and pilot funding to run randomized evaluations (RCTs) measuring real-world impacts of social-good AI deployments.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Evaluate the causal real-world impact of NAAMII's UDAAN AI education tracks on youth employment or TrAI clinical decision tools on patient outcomes.

grants.title: OpenAI Researcher Access Program
grants.amountDisplay: Up to $1,000+ in Subsidized OpenAI API Credits
grants.nepalEligibility: Open globally to academic and non-profit researchers.
grants.summary: Provides free API credits to study responsible AI deployment, multilingual fairness, safety evaluations, and societal/clinical impacts in underrepresented contexts.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Use for benchmarking frontier model hallucinations and cultural/clinical safety in Nepali and South Asian medical queries.

grants.title: Anthropic External Researcher Access & Claude for Science
grants.amountDisplay: $1,000+ API Credits (Scale tiers for AI-for-Science PIs)
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to verified non-profit and academic research investigators.
grants.summary: Monthly-reviewed API credit awards supporting AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and scientific discovery in biology and medicine.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Fast monthly review makes it ideal for student/fellow thesis benchmarks in mechanistic interpretability and low-resource alignment.

grants.title: UNICEF Venture Fund (Open-Source Frontier Tech & AI)
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is a UNICEF programme country. Lead applicant must be a locally registered for-profit startup committed to open-source licensing (NAAMII can partner or spin out).
grants.summary: Equity-free seed funding and mentorship for open-source AI, data science, and digital public goods improving maternal/child health, assistive tech, and youth learning.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Co-apply with a Nepali spin-out or tech implementation partner to commercialize/scale open-source child health or learning tools developed at NAAMII.

grants.title: BMZ / GIZ FAIR Forward & Digital Public Goods Partnerships
grants.funder: BMZ / GIZ Germany & Digital Public Goods Ecosystem
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to Asian and African open-source AI builders, research institutes, and digital public goods maintainers.
grants.summary: Backs open, non-discriminatory AI training data, local-language voice tech (e.g., Common Voice ecosystems), climate/agri AI, and sovereign AI capacity in developing economies.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Register open-source NAAMII health and NLP tools on the Digital Public Goods Registry (DPGA) to unlock DPG-aligned philanthropic and bilateral tenders.

grants.title: Google Academic Research Awards (GARA)
grants.nepalEligibility: Requires PI at a degree-granting institution (co-apply jointly with Tribhuvan Univ., Kathmandu Univ., or international university co-PIs).
grants.summary: Global annual RFP funding fundamental and applied computing research aligned with societal impact, health equity, sustainability, and ML security.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Pair a NAAMII research lead with a joint faculty appointment or Co-PI at KU/TU or an international partner university.

grants.title: APNIC Foundation — Internet & Digital Infrastructure Research Fellowships
grants.nepalEligibility: Directly open to researchers based in APNIC Asia-Pacific economies including Nepal.
grants.summary: Supports 4–8 month empirical technical and policy research mapping internet resilience, local data center/compute readiness, and rural connectivity in Asia-Pacific.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Great focused grant for a NAAMII researcher to publish an authoritative whitepaper on Nepal's Sovereign AI Compute & Healthcare Data Infrastructure readiness.

grants.title: Fondation Botnar — AI, Digital Health & Adolescent Wellbeing
grants.nepalEligibility: Funds LMIC initiatives via regional consortia and global intermediary calls (e.g., Being Initiative, Grand Challenges, WHO/UNICEF youth partnerships).
grants.summary: Invests at the intersection of AI, digital transformation, human rights, and young people's physical and mental wellbeing in growing LMIC cities.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Connect NAAMII's youth network (UDAAN / ANAIS) with mental health and digital wellbeing researchers in Nepal and Switzerland.

grants.title: Patrick J. McGovern Foundation — Data & AI Accelerator / Grants
grants.deadlineDisplay: Annual Data & Society Accelerator Open Call + Strategic Grants
grants.nepalEligibility: Global non-profits (with 501(c)(3) equivalency) are eligible for the open Data & Society Accelerator and strategic grantmaking.
grants.summary: Backs public-purpose AI infrastructure, ethical data engineering, health equity diagnostics, and climate crisis readiness for mission-driven non-profits.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Enter via the open Data & Society Accelerator cohort to build direct donor relationship for larger multi-year institutional infrastructure grants.

grants.title: Schmidt Sciences — AI2050 & Trustworthy AI Solicitations
grants.nepalEligibility: Global researchers and non-profit research institutes are eligible on open Schmidt Sciences RFPs (check individual solicitation rules).
grants.summary: Supports ambitious technical and multidisciplinary research ensuring AI benefits society by 2050—including solving hard problems in global health access, scientific discovery, and model reliability.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Monitor Schmidt Sciences' open RFPs in Trustworthy AI, Climate, and AI in Science, emphasizing real-world deployment challenges unique to LMICs.

grants.title: Nepal Health Research Council (NHRC) — National Health Research Grants
grants.funder: Nepal Health Research Council (Government of Nepal)
grants.deadlineDisplay: Annual Nepali Fiscal Year Calls (Provincial, Postgrad & National)
grants.nepalEligibility: Exclusively for Nepali citizens and Nepal-registered health/research institutions.
grants.summary: Provides national seed funding for priority public health, NCD, infectious disease, and digital health studies in Nepal, alongside national Ethical Review Board (ERB) governance.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Use NHRC grants for junior researchers to gather local clinical baseline data in Nepali hospitals, strengthening subsequent $500K+ EVAH, NIHR, or Fogarty proposals.

grants.title: NAST Young Scientist / Innovation & UGC Nepal Collaborative Research Grants
grants.nepalEligibility: Exclusively for Nepali scientists, innovators, and constituent/affiliated university collaborations.
grants.summary: NAST funds Young Scientist Research Support, Brain Pooling Fellowships, and Technology Innovation Grants; UGC Nepal funds multi-disciplinary Collaborative Research Grants across Engineering, S&T, and Health.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Young NAAMII researchers (<40 yrs) can apply directly to NAST Innovation Grants; co-apply with TU/KU departments for UGC Collaborative Research Grants.

grants.title: Spencer Foundation — Research Grants on Education & AI
grants.deadlineDisplay: Paused Jan–Jun 2027 for Strategic Refresh; Relaunches June 2027
grants.nepalEligibility: Non-U.S. non-profit research organizations and universities in Nepal are directly eligible as Lead Institutions (budgets paid in USD).
grants.summary: Leading global funder of education research, actively supporting empirical studies on AI literacy, equitable computing education, and youth learning ecosystems.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Status Alert: Competitions are paused Jan–Jun 2027 while Spencer redesigns its grantmaking. Prepare a rigorous study around NAAMII's ANAIS & UDAAN AI education cohorts ready for the June 2027 relaunch!

grants.title: Georg Forster Research Fellowship (Developing Countries)
grants.deadlineDisplay: Program Restructuring in Progress — Monitor 2027 Relaunch
grants.nepalEligibility: Designed specifically for researchers from developing countries including Nepal partnering with a German host.
grants.summary: Supports SDG-aligned research stays in Germany plus long-term alumni return fellowships and institutional equipment subsidies in the researcher's home country.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Status Alert: Temporarily paused due to German BMZ program redesign. Bookmark and watch the Humboldt portal in 2027 for the successor developing-country fellowship launch.

grants.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 4: Trustworthy AI, Data & GenAI4EU (2026–2027 Calls)
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is automatically eligible for direct European Commission funding as an LMIC beneficiary in Horizon Europe Research & Innovation Actions (RIA).
grants.summary: Funds frugal/energy-efficient AI, multilingual & culturally diverse LLM evaluation, human-centric robotics, and international AI safety/governance cooperation.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Leverage NAAMII's existing EU grant execution experience (EU UDAAN project) to reassure European coordinators of NAAMII's financial & audit readiness (PIC registration).

grants.title: UK International Science Partnerships Fund (ISPF) — ODA Research & Fellowships
grants.funder: UKRI, British Council & UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
grants.deadlineDisplay: Rolling Bilateral & South Asia Regional Calls (2026–2027)
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is an ODA-eligible South Asian country covered across British Council ISPF Early Career Fellowships and UKRI ODA challenge calls.
grants.summary: Supports UK–LMIC research partnerships and early-career fellowships across four pillars: Resilient Planet, Transformative Technologies (AI/Quantum/Bio), Healthy People, and Tomorrow's Talent.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Monitor British Council Nepal & UKRI Funding Finder for South Asia ODA cohorts; excellent pathway for joint UK-NAAMII postdoc exchanges and workshops.

grants.title: CIFAR Azrieli Global Scholars Program
grants.funder: CIFAR (Canadian Institute for Advanced Research) & Azrieli Foundation
grants.nepalEligibility: Open to early-career PhD researchers worldwide within the first 5 years of a full-time independent research/academic position.
grants.summary: Embeds rising research leaders into CIFAR's elite global research programs (including Learning in Machines & Brains, Multiscale Human, and Future Flourishing) with CAD $100K in flexible research funding.
grants.naamiiStrategy: 2027–2029 cohort closed Nov 4, 2026; early-career PIs at NAAMII should prepare applications in Summer 2027 for the next intake.

grants.title: Schlumberger Foundation — Faculty for the Future (Women in STEM)
grants.nepalEligibility: Specifically restricted to women citizens of developing and emerging economies (including Nepal) committed to returning to strengthen STEM research at home.
grants.summary: Funds PhD and postdoctoral research in computer science, AI, mathematics, and bioengineering at top host universities abroad for women committed to building research capacity in their home countries.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Strong pipeline for female NAAMII research associates and fellows pursuing doctoral/postdoctoral training abroad with a formal commitment to return as NAAMII PIs.

grants.title: The Elsevier Foundation — OWSD Women in Science & Evidence-to-Impact Awards
grants.funder: The Elsevier Foundation & OWSD / The Lancet
grants.deadlineDisplay: Annual Q1 Deadlines (~Feb/March 2027 across themed awards)
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is explicitly eligible under the Asia-Pacific Developing Country / STLC categories.
grants.summary: Recurring competitive awards and targeted SDG partnerships recognizing Global South researchers translating health, climate, and computational evidence into policy and clinical impact.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Track annual Q1 nominations for OWSD-Elsevier Women in Science and Lancet-Elsevier Evidence-to-Impact tracks.

grants.title: Asian Development Bank (ADB) — Digital Health & Regional AI Technical Assistance
grants.funder: Asian Development Bank (ADB) / Digital Technology for Development
grants.deadlineDisplay: Rolling CMS Consulting & Technical Assistance Notices
grants.nepalEligibility: Nepal is an ADB Developing Member Country; Nepali research institutes can register on ADB's Consultant Management System (CMS) as national/regional technical entities.
grants.summary: Finances sovereign digital transformation, national electronic health architecture, AI diagnostic pilots, and disaster-risk modeling across South Asia.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Register NAAMII on ADB's CMS portal to bid on Technical Assistance (TA) packages for Nepal Ministry of Health & Population digital health and climate-risk AI studies.

grants.title: Advancing Bioinformatics, Translational Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Research (R01 Clinical Trial Optional)
grants.nepalEligibility: Verify foreign organization eligibility in Section III of the Grants.gov synopsis (direct LMIC award vs. subaward).
grants.summary: Live federal funding opportunity (PAR-26-040) posted by U.S. Federal Agency matching global health / AI search criteria.
grants.naamiiStrategy: Auto-discovered via weekly Grants.gov API scan. Ensure SAM.gov UEI registration is active before applying.
